title: Kusunoki’s Flunking Her High School Glow-Up
titleEnglish: Kusunoki’s Flunking Her High School Glow-Up
titleRomaji: Kusunoki-san wa Koukou Debut ni Shippaishiteiru
titleNative: 楠木さんは高校デビューに失敗している
synopsis: Keisuke Shizuki and Shizuka Kusunoki are taking high school by storm with their good looks, but they share a dark secret: they were both total outcasts in middle school! While Shizuki has succeeded in making himself over inside and out, clearing the slate of his past life, Kusunoki is still struggling to develop social skills to match her new appearance. She’s eager for Shizuki’s help, if only he could get over his phobia of pretty girls… (Source: Kodansha USA)

synonyms: I Want a Divorce, Please Stop Obsessing Over Me!

synopsis: Edelis Brill, the beloved only daughter of a countess, sees herself stabbed to death by the emperor's sword in a book she discovers in her study. Seeking to change her fate, Edelis rescues the book's sole main character, the slave gladiator Lehan, and pours her endless affection into him. But! Lehan, whom she believed would protect her from the emperor's blade, has returned as the emperor, intent on her heart?! Edelis tries to escape, but Lehan's obsession grows ever stronger... Stop obsessing, divorce me! (Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title: Arabesque Koukyuu no Wakoku-hime
titleNative: アラベスク後宮の和国姫
synopsis: Lyra, a consort whose name will be passed down to future generations as a legend, was originally a princess of the Kingdom of Wa. She was captured in a conspiracy and forced into the harem of the Daril Empire. However, in this harem, she had a path to freedom if she remained childless for several years! This gave her hope, and she resolved not to approach the Sultan, but to wait until her term of indenture expired. However, she was soon tested by the Empress and provoked by a haughty consort candidate. Lyra overcame numerous adversities by displaying the intelligence and natural cheerfulness forged by her parents. She gradually became beloved by those around her, and even showed glimpses of her potential as a wise ruler... But as a result, why has she risen to the top and been treated as a favorite concubine? (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Irina: The Vampire Cosmonaut
synopsis: In an alternate version of the 1960s, two global superpowers have emerged after a savage war: the Zirnitra Union and the United Kingdom of Arnack. East and West are locked in a fierce race to send the first crewed flight into outer space, leading the Union to develop a secret agenda: the Nosferatu Project, which aims to use vampires as spaceflight test subjects. Similar to humans but feared and reviled, vampires are assumed to make the perfect "guinea pigs" for such a dangerous task. Lev Leps, a Union soldier and aspiring cosmonaut, is tasked with overseeing vampire Irina Luminesk aka N44, who has been chosen for the operation–and he can't quite detach his feelings from the vampire girl as planned. Faced with pressure and peril, will either of them manage to fly into the cosmos? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Moriagaranai Date
titleNative: 盛りあがらないデート
synopsis: A So-So Match on a Dating App… Haida, cursed with chronic bad luck, signs up for a dating app as part of her “what-the-heck” phase. She matches with Kuroi, a man who joined for equally reckless reasons. But their conversation never quite clicks, and an unmistakably low-key, awkward mood sets in. Everything they do backfires, resulting in a date that is astonishingly unexciting. Thinking there’s no way there will be a second date in an atmosphere like this… wait, what? Why are they making plans to meet again!? A first date with someone you met on a dating app that just doesn’t take off? The deadpan, surreal banter is way too addictive! A slow-burn, gently unfolding romance that begins with a dating app.

title: MAOYU: Archenemy and Hero "Be Mine, Hero!" "I Refuse!"
titleRomaji: Maoyuu Maou Yuusha: 'Kono Watashi no Mono Tonare, Yuusha yo' 'Kotowaru!'
titleEnglish: MAOYU: Archenemy and Hero "Be Mine, Hero!" "I Refuse!"
titleNative: まおゆう魔王勇者「この我のものとなれ、勇者よ」「断る!」
synopsis: After a long and treacherous journey, our Hero finally arrives at the Dark Lady’s castle only to find himself being asked for help. The Hero explains how the war that the demons have brought upon the humans have killed thousands and put more in misery. The queen of demons however argues that this war has made the human society band together as one and showed empirical evidence how it has increased population, increased production, boosted economy and improved society overall. Furthermore, she explains to the Hero that ending this war will result in a civil war that will produce more bloodshed than there ever was. The Hero, convinced that the only way to bring peace, relatively speaking, is to join forces with the Dark Lady, agrees to help with her plans!
